subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger selection wait for a structured metadata contract?
rationale: Current source still uses `description` as the prompt-visible skill selection signal, but docs also require compact descriptions and a separate open issue proposes structured trigger metadata, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve compact description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps each description short, WHAT+WHEN oriented, and within current prompt-budget guidance.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Leave descriptions compact for now and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that current concise descriptions are intentional and close or redirect related partial PRs and issues as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve compact description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps each description short, WHAT+WHEN oriented, and within current prompt-budget guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is recent ownership of published skill-authoring guidance and embedded skill docs that define description policy.
